entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A human Atarka-clan girl with developing shamanistic powers in the past of Tarkir; granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw and twin of Naiva.

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: Baishya's twin sister, who protects her.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Grandmother of the twins and leader of a hunting band.

entities.name: Kiarka
entities.description: Mother of the twins, a Temur Whisperer killed by Atarka.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Elder dragon who killed Kiarka and forbade shamanistic practices.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A Ghostfire Warrior who shared Shu Yun's knowledge and visions of the origin of Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who appeared at Ugin's grave and nearly conquered Naiva's mind.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon whose vision was sent to Baishya; his secret survival was never revealed to Bolas.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Beings who gave Baishya a vision of the birth of Ugin and the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Eternal Ice
entities.description: A holy mountain Baishya felt the need to climb.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Atarka clan
entities.description: The dragon-ruled clan of Baishya and Naiva.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Destination the band of Yasova set out to find.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Said to be targeting Ugin's grave to trap Bolas, according to the trick played on him.

events.summary: Baishya climbs the Eternal Ice with Naiva, survives an avalanche and goblins, and receives a vision from the Windfolk.
events.quote: Together, they survived an avalanche and an attack by goblins.

events.summary: The band of Yasova flees the Atarka dragons and sets out to find the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: fled the Atarka dragons, who forbade shamanistic practices

events.summary: Atarka confronts the hunting band but is impressed by Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas, sparing them.
events.quote: They were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

events.summary: At Ugin's grave, Bolas nearly conquers Naiva's mind; Baishya and Yasova save her and trick Bolas into fleeing Tarkir.

relations.quote: She was the granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw

relations.note: Killed her for being a Temur Whisperer.
relations.quote: Atarka had killed their mother Kiarka
